emails.subject: SHP-001 compare the SI and the Bill of Lading
emails.snippet: Please compare the Shipping Instruction and the BL for SHP-001 — the BL has not reached us yet.
emails.body:
Hi team,

Please compare the Shipping Instruction and the Bill of Lading for SHP-001 and confirm before release.

The BL has not reached us yet, so only the SI is attached for now.

Thanks,
Lena Hoffmann
Oceanic Logistics GmbH

emails.subject: SHP-002 SI and draft BL attached — please check

emails.body:
Hello,

Attached are the SI and the draft BL for SHP-002. Please check the draft BL against the SI before we issue the original.

Note that the gross weight on the BL is stated in metric tons.

Regards,
Booking Desk
Pacific Carrier

emails.subject: Invoice charges query — INV-7781

emails.body:
Hi,
